goal: Complete the final Android real-device verification of PR #59 old-save migration and record evidence without changing gameplay or save logic.
acceptance_criteria: Back up the user's existing browser save before importing any fixture.
Resume the existing stopped save and complete the post-alchemy explanation and prologue.
Use an official stopped-save fixture with an existing expedition and avoid duplicate guidance or a second dispatch.
Preserve monsters, items, coins, rewards, and expedition records except for documented additive migration and intended progress.
Keep completion state after reload and restore the user's exported save at the end.
Record a clear PR #59 Android verification completion decision.

phases.name: goal_and_boundary
phases.deliverable: Audited current main, AGENTS.md, PR #59 behavior, tutorial progress, save migration, tests, CI, and Pages; fixed the no-delete and backup-first boundary.

phases.name: implementation
phases.deliverable: No gameplay implementation was required. Exported the original save, ran the existing-save route and official legacy fixture route on the same Android browser, and captured screenshots and exported JSON evidence.

phases.name: integration_qa_and_safe_merge
phases.deliverable: Compared before/after saves and confirmed no unintended monster, item, coin, reward, or expedition loss or duplication; the repository full check passed.

phases.name: pages_and_published_verification
phases.deliverable: Ran both verification routes on the current GitHub Pages build and confirmed completion persisted after reload.

phases.name: completion_record_and_stop
phases.deliverable: Recorded the Android result, restored the user's real save, and stopped without selecting another backlog item.

stop_condition: After Cycle 5 Phase 5 is recorded and published, do not select or start another backlog item.
